The stories behind the frame

Where these moments belong.

My films and short clips sit alongside the written journals. Choose a moment in the collection above, then follow its story for the route, photographs and the experience around it.

The Philippines: above and below the water

The coastline, a scooter ride and a whale shark are different windows into my 2025 trip with friends. The full journey moved between Cebu, Oslob, Bohol, Boracay, El Nido and Manila, with plans that changed when a typhoon arrived. The films capture individual scenes; the journal puts those scenes back into the days we actually shared.

Read Beneath the Philippine blue →

Thailand: a personal moment in Bangkok

The Sak Yant film records my own experience with Arjan Neng in Bangkok. It belongs to a separate solo journey, after the three-month exchange that first brought me to Thailand. The solo story follows Bangkok, Chiang Rai and Chiang Mai and gives this moment its personal context.

Read Thailand, on my own →

Bali: a small scene from a longer stay

The flying foxes at Alas Kedaton Monkey Forest are one short moment from my Bali exchange. The wider story includes study life in Denpasar, family time, island detours and the familiar rhythm of Warunk WOW. Reading it alongside the clip shows how a brief scene fits into three months of everyday life and travel.

Read the Bali exchange story →
